description: Deleting any photo of a saved visit always fails. Both the header "Delete" and the thumbnail trash send DELETE /api/api/visits/<id>/photos/<attachmentId> (double "/api"), the backend returns 404 "Cannot DELETE /api/visits/...", and the user sees "Delete failed / Failed to delete photo." Item URLs are already absolutised to "/api/visits/..." by toAbsolute(), then deleteActive() prefixes baseUrl again.
expected: The selected photo is deleted and the strip refreshes.
actual: No saved-visit photo can be removed (blurry or wrong-patient photos stay in the record).
suggested_fix: In deleteActive use active.url as-is when it already starts with baseUrl (or store the raw API path separately from the display URL).

criterion: Destructive action targets what the user chose
description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #4 at request level: with Front active, clicking the trash on the Close-up thumbnail switches the viewer to Close-up and shows "Delete this photo? This cannot be undone." but the DELETE request carries the FRONT attachment id (cmw6ek31n00887dc1xii9qzao = FRONT per GET /visits/visit-seed-5/photos). Only F-405-01 (the 404) currently prevents permanent loss of the wrong photo; the confirm text never names which photo.
expected: Trash on a thumbnail deletes that thumbnail; confirm names position/time.
suggested_fix: Pass the item to delete explicitly (deletePhoto(item)) instead of setActiveIndex + deleteActive; include position in the confirm.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #3: on a walk-in (no visit id yet) two photos uploaded fine ("Before / After Photos (2)", Photos complete, 20%). After the first Save Draft (POST /visits) the visit shows "(0)", "0 Photos", progress back to 0%, and the photos appear only under "Other saved photos → Unattached uploads — 07 Nov 2026 (2)" with no action to attach them.
expected: Draft uploads are claimed by the visit on create (or the visit is created before upload).
actual: Photos silently detached; Photos section un-marked; no recovery action.
suggested_fix: On first save call claim-draft-attachments (backend create) or invoke onVisitNeeded before uploading; offer "Attach to this visit" on unattached uploads.

description: Compare: On defaults "Compare against" to the immediately previous visit (Visit 4) even though it has no photos, so the left pane shows "No photo" for every position; the doctor must open the Select and hunt for a visit that has photos.
expected: Default to the most recent earlier visit that has photos; mark visits without photos in the list.
suggested_fix: Filter/annotate the visit list by photo count and default to the latest with photos.

criterion: Same control duplicated on one screen
description: In compare mode two Prev/Next pairs are stacked (pair navigator and viewer navigator) and the screen carries three kinds of delete control (header Delete, viewer Delete, a red trash on every thumbnail). Compare panes are only ~145px tall at 1280px, too small for a clinical side-by-side.
expected: One navigator; one delete affordance; larger compare panes.
actual: Duplicated navigators and deletes; tiny compare images.
suggested_fix: Hide the viewer navigator while comparing; keep one Delete; give compare panes most of the card height.

description: "Other saved photos" groups are labelled only by date ("Visit — 07 Nov 2026 (3)"); when several visits share a date the doctor cannot tell which visit a group belongs to.
At 390x844 the Photos card is wider than the viewport: header buttons (Camera, Delete) and the Next button are cut off at the right edge; the form still renders in two columns (see F-401-17).
expected: Photos card fits the phone width; controls wrap.
suggested_fix: Stack columns below md; wrap the photo header toolbar.

description: Every visit page load for the seeded patient "patient-seed-1" fires GET /api/billing/invoices?patientId=patient-seed-1 three times, each 400 "patientId must be a UUID or CUID" (seed id format rejected by billing DTO).
suggested_fix: Relax the DTO to accept the seed id format or reseed with cuid ids.
